'''''Legacy of the Force: Fury''''' is the seventh novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It is a paperback book by [[Aaron Allston]] and was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[November 27]], [[2007]].<ref name="Blog-eeusuestornii|9">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|9|Ballantine/Del Rey Fiction Schedule}}</ref> An exclusive hardcover edition was also published by the [[Science Fiction Book Club]]. The [[Legacy of the Force: Fury (abridged audiobook)|audio version]] is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The cover portrays [[Ben Skywalker]].
